notes.title: Demo is on,
notes.notes: [p]game demo is on, featuring the first scene of the game with a level cap of 30.[/p]

notes.title: 1st. PlayTest open
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, as the Steam China 2025 Show Case Festival is on, we'd like to take this opportunity to launch the first round of testing. The game content is still incomplete and features are limited—we sincerely welcome everyone to share your thoughts![/p][p]Note that the playtest will be closed on 2025-0801[/p]
